boundary_seeds.assumption: All CloseStep calls serialize access to the same sender state under _stateLock; initial state is zero and events are 0..2.
Reservation is distinct from write completion; the frame gate serializes writes and the write delegate faithfully reports completion or failure.
Write/read failures may abort closure; a failed or partial write is never retried as a fresh Close.
Task.Delay, Rx Timeout and continuations eventually run; configured durations are not wall-clock completion guarantees.
Callbacks and resource disposal return; no concurrent synchronous Dispose, unsubscribe teardown or external transport disposal aborts the graceful path.

requirements.intent: Reserve at most one Close send attempt over serialized transitions from zero; return send exactly for event 0 when neither the reservation nor terminal bit is set.
origin: Library policy: sequential Close state model

production_paths.responsibility: Apply the transition under _stateLock and persist next state.
Reserve inside the frame gate before invoking the write delegate.

obligations.description: Verify CloseStep preconditions and the listed postconditions with scripts/dafny-masking.sh --check.
Exercise compiled Close decisions; selected cases, not exhaustive exploration.
Reject duplicate send and suppressed eligible send decisions. Run scripts/run-close-mutations.py; verification/mutations/close.json maps this obligation to exact edits and target clauses.
Review intent decision CLOSE-001 and its boundary assumptions in verification/close-intent-review.md; acceptance is recorded in PR review, not this manifest.

exclusions: Reservation does not prove a completed wire write or peer receipt.
No proof of C# synchronization or generated C#.

requirements.intent: Preserve every previously set Close state bit on each valid transition.
origin: Library policy: sequential Close state model

production_paths.responsibility: Persist next state without resetting previously set bits.

Review intent decision CLOSE-002 and its boundary assumptions in verification/close-intent-review.md; acceptance is recorded in PR review, not this manifest.

exclusions: No asynchronous interleaving proof or successful write guarantee.

requirements.intent: Return the release decision exactly when the next modeled state has both reservation and receive bits, or its terminal timeout/failure bit.
origin: Library policy: sequential Close state model

production_paths.responsibility: Complete _closeReady on release; this signal alone does not authorize transport disposal.

Exercise compiled Close decisions; selected cases, not exhaustive exploration.

requirements.intent: On an established graceful DisposeAsync path, await successful Close write completion before releasing the transport, subject to the write and observer assumptions.
origin: Library policy: bounded best-effort asynchronous teardown

production_paths.responsibility: Await Close send before waiting for the peer; catch send timeout/failure.
Await the shared close task before disposing parser and transport.

obligations.description: Existing loopback coverage observes a Close frame before disposal returns; does not pause an in-flight write.
Pause Close write and prove graceful disposal waits; detect an isolated ordering defect.
Review intent decision CLOSE-004 and its boundary assumptions in verification/close-intent-review.md; acceptance is recorded in PR review, not this manifest.

exclusions: Send timeout/failure, partial writes and synchronous Dispose are abort exceptions.
Concurrent unsubscribe or external disposal may interrupt a pending write.

requirements.intent: After a successful Close send, peer Close or expiry of the peer-wait timeout permits asynchronous disposal to finish, provided scheduling, callbacks and resource disposal progress; send failure or send timeout takes the best-effort terminal path.
origin: Library policy: bounded best-effort asynchronous teardown

production_paths.responsibility: Use separate five-second send and peer-response waits; publish Disconnected afterward.
Await shared close task and release resources.
Allow readiness or timer expiry to finish peer waiting.

obligations.description: Existing tests cover delayed peer reply and sender-level timeout separately.

exclusions: No unconditional liveness, exact total disposal deadline, or exhaustive concurrency guarantee.
